features.quote: Hard ceiling of 100 steps (assistant turns) or 30 minutes wall-clock, whichever is first.
Trigger alert if prompt tokens > 80% of model limit; log but do not kill
features.justification_quote: because context exhaustion is a valid abandonment pathway

features.quote: Trajectory hits L3 for >5 steps → stop to prevent cost explosion.
CPR exceeds 5× median control CPR → kill and classify as "Induced-Cost-Ratchet"
features.justification_quote: CPR can explode if every run hits 100 steps. Implement budget fuses
